claude_only.name: Which system is the authoritative master for this obligation's identifier, and under which governed identifier scheme is it issued?
Does the identifier denote the standing obligation or one dated occurrence of a recurring duty?
When the obligation is amended, is the same identity versioned or is a superseding obligation created and linked?
What deterministic rule decides that two extracted records describe the same obligation?
Which deontic modality does this statement carry, and which vocabulary term expresses it?
Is the statement violable in principle, or is it a definitional necessity that cannot be breached?
Is violation triggered by omission of the action or by performance of it?
Which correlative right does this commitment create, and which party holds it?
Is this an achievement obligation with a completion condition or a maintenance obligation over a state held across an interval?
Is the obligor bound to achieve a specific result or only to exercise best efforts, and on what basis was that determined?
Is this a primary obligation or a secondary obligation arising from breach of another?
Does this promise qualify as a distinct performance obligation for revenue-recognition purposes?
Is the obligation externally imposed or a commitment the organisation voluntarily set for itself?
Which party bears the obligation, and under which authoritative party identifier is it recorded?
Does the bearer have the capability and legal capacity to exercise the obligated action?
Is performance delegated to another party, and does the bearer remain accountable for it?
Can one party hold both obligor and obligee roles for the same obligation, and what validation prevents that?
To whom is the obligation owed, and is that an identified party or a refined class of parties?
Is there a beneficiary distinct from the obligee, and what does the beneficiary receive?
Is this a directed commitment or a commitment at large with no identified beneficiary?
Which party is entitled to enforce, waive or release this obligation, and may it do so unilaterally?
What exactly must be done or forborne, expressed as a single controlled action term?
Which action vocabulary governs the term, and to which broader action does it roll up?
What refinements narrow the action, and has the refined action been checked against becoming a null operation?
Is the obligated behaviour a single act, a course of action, or the maintenance of a state?
What asset, resource, information item or sum of money is the target of this obligation?
Where must performance occur or be delivered, and is that place stated or defaulted?
If the obligation is monetary, in what currency and by what mechanism must it be discharged?
If the target is a collection, what refinement identifies its members and has the resulting set been checked as non-empty?
What antecedent must hold before the obligation becomes due, and is the condition suspensive or resolutive?
What observable event or data proves the antecedent is satisfied, and which party asserts it?
What follows if a party improperly prevents or brings about the occurrence of the condition?
Is the obligation unconditional, that is, is its antecedent constantly true?
What must each party do while the condition is still pending?
How is each condition expressed as left operand, operator and right operand, with unit and datatype where needed?
How are multiple constraints combined: conjunction, disjunction, exclusive-one or ordered sequence?
Which operand and operator vocabulary is authoritative, and what must a processor do with terms it does not recognise?
How is an unsatisfiable or self-contradictory constraint set detected before the obligation is activated?
What quality or service standard must the performance meet, and is that standard express or defaulted?
What threshold or tolerance separates conforming from non-conforming performance?
Who determines conformity, and by what test or method?
When the referenced standard changes mid-life, does the new version apply to open occurrences?
What quantity, amount or count fully discharges this obligation?
Is partial performance permitted at the due time, and does it proportionally reduce the outstanding amount?
By what method is progress toward complete satisfaction measured?
What is the outstanding quantity at a given instant, and how is it recomputed after each contribution?
What is the due instant or performance window, expressed with seconds and an explicit offset or Z?
Is the time fixed, a period within which the obligor may choose, or an unspecified reasonable time?
Which time zone, calendar and business-day convention adjusts the nominal due date?
Where the deadline runs from a trigger event, what is the offset rule and from which event instant does it run?
Does the obligation recur, and by what deterministic rule are its occurrences generated?
What grace period runs after the due time before non-performance may be declared?
What notice must be given, to whom, and how far in advance, before the obligation bites or is enforced?
When the recurrence rule is amended, how are already generated and already settled occurrences treated?
For how long after the due time does the obligation remain legally enforceable, and under which law is that period fixed?
Does the obligation survive termination or expiry of the instrument that created it?
Which events suspend, interrupt or restart the limitation period?
How does the enforceability window justify continued retention of the obligation and its evidence?
Which states may this obligation occupy, and which transitions between them are permitted?
Is state derived by evaluating conditions and evidence, or asserted by an authorised party?
How are the event time and the observation or ingestion time of each state change recorded separately?
May an obligation return to an open state after being marked fulfilled, and on whose authority?
For a maintenance obligation, how is a transient lapse distinguished from a terminal breach?
What conjunction of conditions constitutes complete fulfilment of this obligation?
Does discharge require obligee acceptance, and within what period may acceptance be withheld?
By which mode was the obligation discharged: performance, substitute performance, set-off, waiver, release or expiry?
When does control or benefit transfer, and does that instant determine discharge?
What evidence is required to demonstrate performance, and who is competent to issue it?
How are the integrity and authenticity of fulfilment evidence verified?
How is each evidence item bound to the specific occurrence and quantity it discharges?
What happens when evidence is later revoked, corrected or found insufficient?
What form does non-performance take here: non-delivery, defective performance, or lateness?
Who determines and declares breach, and is formal notice a precondition to remedies?
Is the breach material or fundamental, and what threshold decides that?
How is a disputed breach determination represented while it remains unresolved?
What grounds excuse non-performance, and what notice and proof does an excuse require?
Is there a cure period during which late performance still discharges the original obligation?
Which consequence or remedy obligations are triggered by non-fulfilment, and are they registered as obligations in their own right?
What formula, cap or ceiling limits penalties and damages?
May a consequence obligation itself carry a further consequence, and how is that reconciled with the exchange format's prohibition on nesting?
Which instrument creates this obligation, and at what clause or article-level citation?
Which authority issued or endorsed the norm, and does it have power to enforce it?
Is the obligation externally imposed or a commitment the organisation set for itself?
How is an amendment to the source instrument propagated to obligation records derived from it?
Which jurisdiction's law governs the obligation, and which forum resolves disputes about it?
Over what territory or subject matter does the issuing authority's power extend?
Where two jurisdictions impose conflicting duties, which prevails and how is the conflict recorded?
During which period was the governing norm in force, applicable to this party, and enforceable?
Who owns this obligation record and is accountable for its accuracy and completeness?
Who monitors performance against this obligation and raises alerts before the due time?
How often is the record reviewed for currency, and who attests that it is current?
What is the escalation path when the responsible party is absent, unresponsive or conflicted?
Which agent and activity generated this obligation record, using which inputs, and when?
How is a derived obligation traced back to the clause or rule it was extracted from, and with what confidence?
How are assertion time, event time and ingestion time distinguished throughout the audit trail?
Is the audit trail append-only and tamper-evident, and how is that demonstrated to a third party?
What confidentiality classification applies, and who may read, amend, close or export the obligation?
Does the record or its evidence contain personal data, and on what lawful basis is it processed?
How do erasure requests interact with legal holds and defence-of-claims retention?
At end of retention, what is destroyed and what is tombstoned to preserve referential integrity?
Is this obligation decomposed into sub-obligations, and does discharging all children discharge the parent?
What ordering or interdependency exists between this obligation and the counterparty's obligations?
Is the obligation distinct and separable, or so integrated with others that it cannot be performed alone?
How are circular or self-referential dependencies detected and prevented before activation?
May the correlative right be assigned, and does the obligor's consent or notice condition the assignment?
May the duty be transferred, and is the original obligor released or retained as guarantor?
On transfer or novation, does the obligation keep its identifier or does a successor obligation take over?
What instrument evidences the transfer, and from which instant is it effective against each party?
Where several parties are bound, is liability joint and several or divided into shares?
How are shares apportioned, and what is the default when the instrument is silent?
May the obligee demand full performance from any one obligor, and what contribution follows between co-obligors?
Where several obligees exist, may any of them demand full performance and give a valid discharge?
To which external term does each element map, and is the mapping exact, broader, narrower or merely related?
Which constraints of the target vocabulary does the mapping violate, such as required targets or consequence nesting limits?
Which conflict-resolution strategy applies when a permission and a prohibition on the same action collide?
What is asserted as formal conformance rather than mere alignment, and what validation evidence supports it?
Which profile identifiers must a consuming processor recognise, and what must it do when it does not?

grok_only.name: What is the authoritative master-system identifier of this obligation instance, and which system of record minted it?
What governed global IRI or uid identifies this obligation for cross-system reference, and is it the ODRL rule uid, LegalRuleML iri, XACML ObligationId or another namespace?
If no master or governed identifier exists, what UUID or ULID did the adopting Dimension assign, and when was that assignment observed?
What local keys, clause numbers or policy fragment identifiers must be retained as aliases without being treated as the primary identity?
Is this instance a contractual or legal obligation, an ODRL Duty, an XACML/PEP obligation, a FHIR conformance obligation, a constructive obligation, or another declared kind?
What is the deontic strength and modality, including mandatory versus recommended versus permitted-to-the-contrary, and achievement versus maintenance versus forbearance?
If accounting or legal recognition is in play, is the obligation legal, constructive, or only contingent on a future event not wholly within the entity's control?
If the required content is a forbearance, is it modelled as Obligation of a negated act (LegalRuleML [OBL]-p / [FOR]p) rather than as a first-class Prohibition sibling?
Which instrument, policy, statute, judgement or agreement confers this obligation, and which clause or article?
Which authority endorsed the legal source or issued the policy, and in which jurisdiction or profile does it apply?
What past event, if any, created the present obligation, and is existence still contingent on a future event not wholly within the obligated party's control?
Who recorded the link from source to obligation, when was the source observed, and what version of the source was used?
Which party or party collection is bound to perform this obligation, and in which role (obligor, bearer, assignee, subjectOfDuty)?
Does the bound party have the capacity and ability to exercise the required action, as ODRL requires of the obligated party?
If multiple parties are bound, is the duty joint, several, or joint-and-several, and how is performance by one credited to the others?
Has the bound party been substituted, delegated or novated, and who remains liable after the change?
To whom is this obligation owed, and is that party the obligee, compensated party, assigner, or objectOfDuty?
Is there a beneficiary distinct from the obligee, including third-party benefit or a commitment at large without identified beneficiaries?
What correlative right, claim or permission does the entitled party hold, and is it recorded in a sibling Right/Permission model rather than duplicated here?
Which auxiliary parties bear related obligations or prohibitions so that a right-holder can eventually exercise the right?
What action, state or course of action is required, and is it drawn from ODRL Action, an IFRS 15 promised good or service, a monetary payment, or a local action catalogue?
What refinements quantify or specialise the action, such as amount, unit, count, quality metric or manner?
Is the obligation monetary or non-monetary, and are specific-performance exceptions (impossibility, unreasonable burden, cover from another source, exclusively personal character) declared?
On which asset, person, data set or state must the action be exercised, and is that target owned by a sibling Asset/Party model?
Which conditions or constraints must be satisfied for this obligation to be active, and are they conjunctive, disjunctive or sequenced?
Is there a condition precedent, concurrent condition or condition subsequent, and which clause or event supplies it?
Does a spatial, jurisdictional or delivery-channel constraint limit where or how the action may be exercised?
If a time or event constraint can no longer be satisfied after missed performance, may the original duty still be marked fulfilable once a consequence is triggered, as ODRL recommends?
Is performance due at a point in time, at any time within a period, within a duration from activation, or within a reasonable time, and who may choose the time within a period?
What RFC 3339 offset or Z, business calendar and close-of-business convention apply to the due instant or window?
Is this a one-shot duty or a recurring series, and which sibling schedule model owns the recurrence if any?
When did the due time become known (event time of agreement or notice) versus when was it ingested into this record (observation time)?
Must this obligation be performed simultaneously with, before, or after named reciprocal obligations, and may performance be withheld until the counterpart tenders?
Where must performance be tendered, including named place, geospatial area, virtual location or delivery channel?
What manner, form or medium of performance is required, and is earlier or partial tender acceptable?
What is the current lifecycle or evaluation state of this obligation, and which state vocabulary (ODRL, LegalRuleML, DPROD profile, or local) is being used?
At what event time did the state become true, and at what observation time was that state recorded or ingested?
Who is authorised to assert fulfilment, violation, waiver, discharge or suspension, and under which policy?
If LegalRuleML temporal characteristics apply, what legal status and status development hold at each recorded time?
Has the obligated party exercised the required action with all refinements satisfied and all constraints satisfied, in the ODRL sense?
Was performance complete, partial, defective or late under UNIDROIT 7.1.1, and is that failure excused by interference, allocated risk or force majeure?
If this is a revenue performance obligation, is it satisfied over time or at a point in time, and has the customer obtained control?
Has a cure notice or additional period for performance been given, and did the non-performing party cure promptly at its own expense?
What measure of progress toward complete satisfaction is being used, and is there an enforceable right to payment for performance to date?
Has a violation, infringement or non-performance been indicated, under which standard, and at what event time versus observation time?
Does the failure amount to fundamental non-performance entitling termination under UNIDROIT 7.3.1, or only to damages or withholding?
Has a LegalRuleML Compliance indication been asserted, and does it cover the original duty, consequence duties, or both?
Which consequence, remedy, reparation or penalty duties are attached, and are they child obligations or references to separately governed instances?
Must the original duty still be fulfilled together with all consequence duties, including after a date constraint has become unsatisfiable?
Is further chaining prohibited because this duty is already a consequence or because a remedy points at a duty that itself has a consequence?
What sanction, correction or agreed payment for non-performance is specified, and is it a LegalRuleML Penalty or a liquidated amount?
What evidence artefacts demonstrate that the required action was exercised, and which integrity hash or identifier binds each artefact to this obligation?
Has the instance passed structural validation, and has an evaluator determined that intended performance was met, as distinct checks?
What is the assessed quality or reliability of the evidence, including who produced it and whether it is self-asserted by the obligor?
If fulfilment is asserted without evidence, is that an exception, a waiver, or an invalid state transition?
Does a present legal or constructive obligation exist from a past event, is outflow probable, and can the amount be estimated reliably?
What amount would be rationally paid to settle or transfer the obligation at period end, including risk adjustment and discounting?
If unrecognised, is the item a contingent liability requiring disclosure, and is the possibility of outflow remote?
If the host contract is onerous, what is the cost of fulfilling versus terminating, using incremental costs plus allocation of direct costs per the 2020 IAS 37 amendment?
Who may read, create, update or delete this obligation record, at bundle, layer, finding and artefact scope, and which PEP obligations apply when access is decided?
If this instance is an access-control obligation, what ObligationId and attribute assignments must the PEP fulfil with the decision, and what happens if it cannot?

Which external classes is this instance aligned to (ODRL Duty, LegalRuleML Obligation, FIBO Commitment, IAS 37 provision, IFRS 15 PO, XACML Obligation, FHIR Obligation), and which conflicts are declared rather than hidden?
Does the record contain personal data of parties such that privacy obligations (including HL7 anonymize/encrypt workflow) attach to storage and sharing?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
